datasets.name: ds_ibm_kpis
queryLines:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(Churn_Value) AS churned_customers,
    COUNT(*) - SUM(Churn_Value) AS retained_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(Churn_Value) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate_percent,
    ROUND(AVG(Monthly_Charges), 2) AS avg_monthly_charges,
    ROUND(AVG(Tenure_Months), 1) AS avg_tenure_months
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn;

datasets.name: ds_churn_contract
queryLines:
SELECT
    Contract,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(Churn_Value) AS churned_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(Churn_Value) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate_percent
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
GROUP BY Contract
ORDER BY churn_rate_percent DESC;

datasets.name: ds_churn_payment
queryLines:
SELECT
    Payment Method AS payment_method,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(Churn_Value) AS churned_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(Churn_Value) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate_percent
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
GROUP BY Payment Method
ORDER BY churn_rate_percent DESC;

datasets.name: ds_churn_service
queryLines:
SELECT
    Internet Service AS internet_service,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(Churn_Value) AS churned_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(Churn_Value) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate_percent
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
GROUP BY Internet Service
ORDER BY churn_rate_percent DESC;

datasets.name: ds_churn_tenure
queryLines:
SELECT
    tenure_band,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    SUM(Churn_Value) AS churned_customers,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(Churn_Value) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) AS churn_rate_percent
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN Tenure_Months <= 12 THEN '0-12 months'
            WHEN Tenure_Months <= 24 THEN '13-24 months'
            WHEN Tenure_Months <= 48 THEN '25-48 months'
            ELSE '49+ months'
        END AS tenure_band,
        Churn_Value
    FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
)
GROUP BY tenure_band
ORDER BY churn_rate_percent DESC;

datasets.name: ds_churn_reasons
queryLines:
SELECT
    Churn Reason AS churn_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
WHERE Churn_Value = 1
GROUP BY Churn Reason
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

datasets.name: ds_charges_analysis
queryLines:
SELECT
    Churn Label AS churn_label,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(Monthly_Charges), 2) AS avg_monthly_charges,
    ROUND(MIN(Monthly_Charges), 2) AS min_monthly_charges,
    ROUND(MAX(Monthly_Charges), 2) AS max_monthly_charges,
    ROUND(SUM(Monthly_Charges), 2) AS total_monthly_revenue
FROM workspace.silver.ibm_telco_customer_churn
GROUP BY Churn Label;
